verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cloudflare offers a 'globally distributed key-value' store (KV) and a separate Queues product, but nothing says either is Redis-compatible. Proprietary KV plus a separate queue service is an adjacent capability, not the Redis-compatible store the story names, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues
